# INFO

This is just the example refactor for our AFP code.

End date is last day of the previous month

```{r packages}
library(sirfunctions)
library(DT)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(crosstalk)
library(cowplot)

```

```{r parameter}

end_date <- ceiling_date(Sys.Date() %m-% months(1), unit = "month") %m-% days(1)

invisible(lapply(list.files("R"), \(fx) source(file.path("R", fx))))
```

```{r}
raw_data <- get_all_polio_data(attach.spatial.data = FALSE)
```

```{r}
afp_cases_reported <- build_afp_cases_reported(raw_data$afp, end_date) 
```

# EXAMPLE TABLE

```{r}
datatable(
  afp_cases_reported$data |>
    dplyr::rename(
      Region = "whoregion",
      Country = "place.admin.0",
      Month = "month_label"
    ),
  options = list(scrollX = TRUE) )
```
